idea-plugin.name: Solarized Osaka
idea-plugin.description:
Solarized Osaka

A clean, dark (and light) Solarized-inspired theme for all JetBrains IDEs.

Inspired by the Neovim theme solarized-osaka.nvim by craftzdog.

Features slightly brightened base colors for modern displays and a rich accent palette.

Themes included

  • Solarized Osaka – Classic Dark
  • Solarized Osaka Light – Classic Light
  • Solarized Osaka Islands – Dark for Islands UI (2025.3+)
  • Solarized Osaka Islands Light – Light for Islands UI (2025.3+)
